extras: The plugin does not collect telemetry or analytics. It uses specific conflict files (note.conflict-<device>.md) to prevent data loss during simultaneous edits.
problem: Maintaining consistent, up-to-date knowledge between a local Markdown vault and an external AI memory service is complex.

relations.evidence: Sync a Ryphos memory with a folder in your vault

summary: Ryphos sync tool connects a Ryphos memory to a local vault folder, synchronizing Markdown content bi-directionally.
